entry.name: panelView
entry.label: In a panel: "clusters" (one button per cluster) or "map" (a small map); either opens the full map.

entry.name: toScale
entry.label: Draw the plane to scale. Off, empty ground between clusters is squeezed so every cluster reads.

entry.name: showMinimized
entry.label: Show minimized windows in a tray along the map's foot; a click brings one back.

entry.name: livePreviews
entry.label: Live window pictures while the map is looked at (never while a game has the focus, never for a window hidden from capture).
